headline.reading: All three moved together, and the largest moves are on held-out tasks the tuning never touched. That is the signature of capability, not of a tuning-set artefact.

the_significance_test_i_ran_against_my_o.method: paired per-task difference on the 90 held-out tasks
the_significance_test_i_ran_against_my_o.honest_verdict: NOT significant at p<0.05 at this sample size. The aggregate gain cannot yet be separated from noise. The individual fixes below are verified separately at 8-10 reps with page identity checked and those stand on their own.

the_three_defects_and_why_they_took_thre.1_the_shape_is_not_text: candidates() queries button,a,li,div,span,input,label -- an SVG <circle> is not in it. Geometry now read from circle/rect/image/svg/polygon.
the_three_defects_and_why_they_took_thre.2_the_canvas_is_also_geometry: that list holds both the <svg> (20800 px) and the <circle> (784 px). Taking the first picked the canvas. The smallest visible element is the draggable.
the_three_defects_and_why_they_took_thre.3_the_sentence_contains_the_word_it_name: 'Drag the circle left...' matched 'Drag the circle left then press Submit.' at (80,25) -- the #query instruction div -- and the code dragged the instruction. Excluding the page's own #query box was worth BOTH remaining drag tasks.
the_three_defects_and_why_they_took_thre.why_three_rounds: Each was found by PRINTING WHAT THE CODE CHOSE, not by reasoning about it. Every round I reasoned instead, I changed the wrong thing and the number stayed at zero.

gesture_defect_affecting_the_whole_famil.statement: Input.dispatchMouseEvent defaults `buttons` to 0. jQuery UI Sortable's _mouseMove returns early unless the button is reported held, so every move looked like a hover.
gesture_defect_affecting_the_whole_famil.evidence: before ['Annora','Allys','Johnette','Belle','Roxi'] -> after ['Allys','Annora','Johnette','Belle','Roxi'] once buttons:1 is set
gesture_defect_affecting_the_whole_famil.scope: all 8 drag tasks scored 0/24 before this

verified_individually_at_high_rep.drag-sort-numbers: 0/30 -> 10/10 (bubble sort by adjacent drags; placement by absolute target gave 1/10)

still_zero_and_why.drag-box: runs the #draggableSmall/#draggableLarge path and scores 0 -- the two-box containment shape is not solved
still_zero_and_why.drag-items-grid: 'Drag Amara to the bottom right' is a 2-D destination and only 1-D is implemented
